Student spotlight

Stories from the scholars and partners of the ISA Scholarship Program.

3 May 2024, Peñablanca, CagayanFirst scholar: Aldwin Jeam T. Mueco

ISA Australia and MCNP–ISAP sign an agreement to launch a scholarship program

ISA Australia partnered with the Medical Colleges of Northern Philippines and the International School of Asia and the Pacific to provide full scholarships to academically promising students facing financial hardship.

The first recipient is Aldwin Jeam T. Mueco, a Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management student at ISAP, chosen for his academic performance, class participation and leadership. Dona Taguinod-Leach and MCNP–ISAP President Dr Christian Guzman both committed to supporting students with guidance as well as funding.

Signing day

3 May 2024, Peñablanca, Cagayan. Photos: The Quill, the official student publication of MCNP–ISAP.

CC
Chryzianne J. CruzGrade 12 STEM, Logac National High School, Lal-lo

A question about pain that became a calling

Hearing a nurse ask a patient to rate their pain from 1 to 10 showed Chryzianne her purpose: bringing healing and hope through healthcare. She was inspired by her mother’s quiet strength and the health workers in her community.

  • Strong academic record in the STEM strand
  • Committed to serving her community
“Being a scholar for ISA Australia gives me a better hope for the bright future ahead.”
Read more about Chryzianne
GT
Godly Kate TactacGrade 11 Home Economics, Sta. Teresita National High School

Resilience grows where roots run deep

From the rice fields of Dungeg to Sta. Teresita National High School, Godly Kate is the eldest daughter of a farmer and a homemaker. She balances housework, farm life and school, and keeps a consistent honor record.

“Every financial obstacle my family faces becomes a reason to work harder.”
